newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Tigon raises 49.8 mln rand by share issue.
newsitem.headline: Tigon raises 49.8 mln rand by share issue.

text.p: Tigon Ltd said on Tuesday that it had raised 49.8 million rand by way of issuing 5.75 million ordinary shares at 867 cents per share.
Tigon said it had issued the shares to a leading fund management institution, selected organisations, private investors and certain Tigon shareholders.
"Tigon is experiencing exponential growth. In order to sustain this growth, it has been necessary to raise further capital," the company said.
Application has been made for the listing of the 5.75 ordinary shares on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange from the start of business on Wednesday.
